summary: Anthropic researchers introduce TASTE, a benchmark that measures how well AI models judge pairs of AI safety research proposals against human researcher preferences, finding models score 60% versus human agreement of 77%.

practices.reason: Introduces a benchmark and methodology (discussion stage, confidence filtering) for measuring model judgment on hard-to-verify research evaluation tasks that could inform internal eval design.
practices.quote: We built TASTE (The AI Safety Taste Evaluation) — a benchmark measuring how well models can judge pairs of AI safety research proposals, scored by agreement with the preferences of experienced human researchers.
